question: Does the three-study nominal POSITIVE association between daily ERA5 Tmax and night-minus-day GPS step-speed q persist within an original tagged animal/year/calendar-month after controlling local modeled astronomical daylength and antecedent 30-day P−ET0; how distinct is q~L|Tmax,water?
climate_data_second_read_policy: Download the exact previous GPS original UUID/bytes/MD5 and replay original q and daylight group n+means. Re-fetch ERA5 1deg daily model=era5 for every pre-existing source-selected q date; re-generate full source daily physical SHA256 including original private cells and dates and require EXACT equality to first verified 2026-11-16 source physical content fingerprints. Reject partial or revised weather grids rather than reclassifying old positive coefficient.
previous_daily_weather_endpoints_replay: Recompute all six previously complete daily year/individual weather model endpoint n/means for the same source, strict tolerance 1e-10, before within-calendar-month conditioning. The old historical raw-JSON SHA 12 HOLD is never changed.
private_original_tag_month_q: Per previously q-qualified original tagged animal-year date, attach provider ERA5 Tmax and complete previous 30d P−ET0/100 mm at same GPS-observed private 1deg cell. Each calendar year-month is one within-tag panel: at least 5 source q-qualified weather-complete dates and >=0.05 h original local-daylength range. >=2 distinct admissible months, >=15 original dates and >=0.05 hours² total demeaned daylength Sxx within each original animal-year. Select on original date/weather support only; never on q, coeff signs.
primary_models: Calculate two coefficients by OLS on within-tag/year-month centered Tmax, P−ET0/100mm, daylength, q: Tmax|daylength+water and daylength|Tmax+water, using the same rows/animals/months. Require full 3-predictor residual rank and for each jointly admitted original tagged year: after joint residualization of other two predictors, predictor SD >=0.25 C for Tmax, >=0.05 h for daylength, >=0.05 (100mm units) for water, and at least 15 q-qualified dates. Subject-year fitted slopes for ALL THREE predictors on identical data; equal original eligible years per tagged individual; equal original eligible tagged animals within source; original-tag 2000 fixed seed bootstrap nominal 95 CI.
paired_raw_vs_month_FE: On the EXACT SAME month-qualified original tag/day/weather observations as primary, also calculate an unadjusted-month/intercept joint OLS q~Tmax+L+water (all other data restrictions unchanged). Original tagged bootstrap resamples must be SHARED between paired unadjusted-vs-month FE coefficient changes. Never compare independent bootstrap source CIs as if correlated matched contrast.
joint_control_collinearity_maximal_condi: FWL residualization for two covariates with determinant ratio>=0.01, original source helper unchanged
